text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
That was the best race ever!
Fine Motion, keep on running for us~!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Incredible...
It's like the cheers are raining down on us.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"It's because your running was so magnificent,
Fine-san. I couldn't help but cry out..."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Even I was shaken to the core.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Even though I lost... I feel like it was
such a fun, blissful race.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
—I'm sure everyone will be
talking about today's race.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
choice_data_list: We still have time, don't we?
We still have time, don't we?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I can still run anywhere, and as far as we want...
with you!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Until the day our true farewell awaits.
Let's make the best memories together!
